Independent full topological sort confirms all four matched cover graphs acyclic, not merely matching counts. Reduced discrete Morse identifies the 30-point complex as S4 and link as wedge of five S6. Because d_H(p,bar p)=5>3, the link at the second deleted vertex remains unchanged; both vertex-deletion cofibers equal suspensions of the same link, wedge of five S7. Long exact integral homology sequences give H4 isomorphisms and two primitive rank-five H7 losses. XOR-translation symmetry covers all 16 antipodal pairs; no dimension-uniform extrapolation is claimed.
